app.name: Smart VCard
app.description: Fill in your details once, proof the card live, then hand it over as a QR code, a .vcf file, a PNG or a printed card. Everything is generated in this tab.

home.titleAccent: hand over a card with a scan.
home.subtitle: Fill it in once, proof it on the spot, then hand it over as a QR code, a .vcf, a PNG or a printed card. Nothing leaves this tab.
home.specimenNote: Rendered by the exact component you will use — not a mock-up.

ledger.title: Four lines this tool will not cross
ledger.subtitle: Only the four things that change how the tool feels in use. No feature padding.

bilingual.title: Two languages, one identity
bilingual.desc: Chinese and English share the same fields. The name order follows the name itself, so a card never reads backwards.

dual.title: Two ways to scan
dual.desc: A web link for WeChat and chat apps, or a raw vCard for the system camera. Choose per audience.

local.title: Nothing leaves the tab
local.desc: No account, no upload, no analytics. Contact details are processed by your own browser and only stored when you keep a draft.

install.title: Works on a bad connection
install.desc: Install it to the home screen and the studio keeps working offline — useful at a venue with no Wi-Fi.

flow.title: From blank to handover
flow.subtitle: No wizard and no sign-up wall. The specimen updates while you type.

one.title: Lay out the identity
one.desc: Name, role, organisation, address, social handles. Empty fields never produce empty vCard lines.

two.title: Check the specimen
two.desc: Watch the card and QR update live. Change module style, ink colour and QR payload before you commit.

three.title: Export or share
three.desc: Download .vcf, PNG or SVG, copy the vCard text, print the card, or send a link that opens this page.

privacy.title: A card is personal data. Keep it personal.
privacy.body: Smart VCard has no server. Drafts live in this browser's localStorage; a share link carries the data inside the URL fragment, which is never sent to the host.

closing.title: Your next introduction can be a scan.
closing.body: Open the studio, fill in what matters, and leave with a card that works in WeChat, on iOS and on Android.

form.subtitle: Everything is optional except a name. The specimen and QR update as you type.
form.draftHint: Draft saves automatically after you pause.

form.sloganHint: One line at the bottom of the card

form.noteHint: Up to 1000 characters; long notes are folded correctly in the .vcf
form.submitHint: Saving only writes a draft to this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
form.logoWrongType: Pick an image file (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG).
form.logoTooLarge: That image is larger than 1 MB.
form.logoReadError: The image could not be read.
form.resetDesc: Every field, the logo and the local draft will be removed. This cannot be undone.
form.backupExported: Backup exported (draft, logo and QR settings).
form.backupConfirmDesc: Your current draft, logo and QR settings will be replaced with the backup. This cannot be undone.
form.backupInvalid: That file is not a valid backup.
form.backupTooLarge: That backup file is too large.

errors.invalidUrl: Use a full http:// or https:// address.
errors.invalidImage: Use an http(s) image URL or upload a file.

preview.deliveryHint: Pick what the QR carries, how it looks, and how the card leaves this tab.
preview.tooLongHint: This payload is too dense for a reliable QR. Shorten the note, or switch the QR to a web link.
preview.linkUnavailable: This card is too large to carry in a link. Switch to raw vCard, or shorten the note.
preview.sharePasswordPlaceholder: Leave empty for an unencrypted link

qrMode.label: QR carries
qrMode.vcardHint: WeChat's scanner cannot read vCard QR codes. Use this only when recipients scan with the iOS or Android camera.
qrMode.formatHint: MeCard is DoCoMo's compact flavour: it carries no company or title, so the same card yields a sparser, easier-to-scan symbol; vCard keeps every field. Only system cameras read either — WeChat reads neither.
qrMode.urlHint: Chat apps open this page, where one tap saves the contact. Best for WeChat and printed cards.

import.title: Import a vCard
import.description: Paste vCard text or choose a .vcf file. Known properties refill the sheet; everything else is ignored.
import.errorTooLarge: That file is larger than 256 KB.
import.errorRead: The file could not be read.
import.errorInvalid: No vCard properties were found in that text.
import.successMultiple: Found {{count}} cards — the first one was loaded.

share.pageDescription: Save this contact to your address book.
share.saveHint: The .vcf opens in your system contacts app. On iOS, use Share → Contacts if the file only previews.
share.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text manually.
share.shareUnsupportedCopied: No share sheet here, so the link was copied.
share.wechatHint: In WeChat, tap ··· and choose “Open in Browser” — contact files do not download inside the in-app browser.

share.invalidTitle: This link does not contain a readable card
share.invalidDesc: The payload is missing, truncated or was edited. Ask the sender for a fresh link.

about.title: About this tool
about.intro: Smart VCard is a small, local-first studio for turning contact details into a card you can scan, save or print. It began as a fork and was rebuilt around a stricter vCard writer and the Indigo Grid visual system.

local.title: Local by default
local.desc: There is no backend. Drafts live in localStorage; exports are produced in the tab; share links carry the payload in the fragment.

interop.title: Interoperable, not clever
interop.desc: The writer emits conservative vCard 3.0, folds long lines at 75 octets and preserves international phone prefixes.

legible.title: Legible on paper
legible.desc: The card is measured in blocks, weight and hairlines — not decoration. It survives a monochrome printer and a small phone screen.

quiet.title: No dark patterns
quiet.desc: No account wall, no upsell, no watermark, no telemetry, and nothing asks for an email address.

about.stackNote: Versions are pinned in package-lock.json. No UI framework beyond Tailwind utilities.
about.interopBody: Most of the hard work is invisible: the details that make a card land correctly in someone else's contacts app.

interopPoints.format: vCard 3.0 with a conventional property order; the N property always has five components.
interopPoints.wechat: Two QR payloads, because WeChat's scanner refuses raw vCard.
interopPoints.folding: CRLF endings, 75-octet folding and escaped separators, so long notes survive intact.
interopPoints.privacy: Remote images are exported as URI references; uploads are never embedded in share links.

about.creditsBody: Originally forked from farellukas/vcard-generator. The writer, card layout, studio UI and bilingual copy were rebuilt for this release.
